rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying something usually happens, whether you mean most of the time or as the normal expectation.

example.english: I usually get up at seven in the morning.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 ziu1 zou2 cat1 dim2 hei2 san1

rows.note: Use this for what happens in ordinary circumstances or as part of someone's normal routine, rather than for a precise frequency estimate.

example.english: I usually take the bus home after work.
example.traditional: 平時我收工返屋企都搭巴士。
example.jyutping: ping4 si4 ngo5 sau1 gung1 faan1 uk1 kei2 dou1 daap3 baa1 si2
